entries.title: A growing number of young victims whose photos were sexualized using Grok are seeking to hold xAI legally accountable for allowing users to generate such images (Alexandra S. Levine/Bloomberg)
Munich-based Agile Robots, which develops humanoids, mobile robots, robotic arms, and control software, raised $500M led by SoftBank at an $8.5B valuation (Marilen Martin/Bloomberg)
Radical Numerics unveils Omnii Defense, an edge AI model it says can identify natural and AI-engineered pathogens without an internet connection (Emily Mullin/Wired)
Sources: Chinese AI companies are rushing to rent Nvidia compute capacity overseas amid fears of tighter US restrictions after the Jensen Huang spy scandal (Reuters)
China hawks and Big Tech critics on Capitol Hill are building bipartisan support for tighter export controls as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang falls out of favor in DC (Joe Miller/Financial Times)
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue after the quarter ended July 2025, when it accounted for 22% of its revenue, after placing Megaspeed on a blocklist (Jonathan Weil/Wall Street Journal)
AMD shares rose 4%+ after hours after closing up 7.3%, while Broadcom gained 2.4% after hours following a 4% gain, as Nvidia's board weighs ousting CEO Huang (Financial Times)
Sources: some Trump officials questioned Jensen Huang's push for Trump to allow more chip sales to China, even before his affair with Alice Huang became public (Wall Street Journal)
Sources: the Commerce Department is finalizing a semiconductor control update that would prevent remote access and chip smuggling into China via data centers (Leo Schwartz/The Information)
Sources: some Nvidia board members favor naming CFO Colette Kress interim CEO; an administration official says the board briefed the White House on its meeting (Semafor)
Letter: Sens. Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons ask the Trump administration to preserve all documents tied to Nvidia's chip exports to China and Huang's affair (Wall Street Journal)
Sources: Megaspeed founder Alice Huang has returned to China; a source says she is currently living in Beijing with the knowledge of security officials (Bloomberg)
Roku says it will wind down sales of smart home hardware to focus on streaming, days after Fox closed its acquisition; it will keep supporting existing devices (Janko Roettgers/Lowpass)
Source: Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify possible replacements for Jensen Huang and weighs naming a temporary CEO during the search (Bloomberg)
Sources: CoreWeave plans to raise $4B+ via an investment-grade loan as soon as next week; CoreWeave says it may yield 7%-7.5%, about half its junk bonds' yield (Jeannine Amodeo/Bloomberg)
